items.sentence1: It was a mistake for us not to book the tickets in advance.

explanation.en: Part 1: criticism of a past action is expressed with 'should have'. Part 2: it is followed by the past participle 'booked'; 'should have book' or 'should booked' are wrong.
explanation.cs: Část 1: výčitka za minulost = should have (měli jsme). Část 2: následuje příčestí minulé booked.

items.sentence1: No other student in the class is anywhere near as talented as Mia.
fullAnswers: far and away the most talented
far more talented than any other

explanation.en: Part 1: 'by far' (or 'far and away') intensifies a superlative. Part 2: the superlative 'the most talented' replaces 'no other student is as talented'. 'Far more talented than any other' is also correct.
explanation.cs: Část 1: by far = zdaleka, jednoznačně (zesiluje 3. stupeň). Část 2: superlativ the most talented. Správně je i far more talented than any other.

items.sentence1: Visitors must not feed the animals, whatever the situation.

explanation.en: Part 1: 'whatever the situation' becomes 'Under no circumstances', which is followed by a modal or auxiliary. Part 2: the subject 'visitors' comes after the modal (inversion), and the sentence no longer needs 'not'.
explanation.cs: Část 1: Under no circumstances (za žádných okolností) + modální sloveso. Část 2: inverze, podmět visitors stojí až za slovesem. Zápor not už nepatří, je obsažen v 'no'.

items.sentence1: I'd prefer you not to mention this to anyone.

explanation.en: Part 1: 'would rather' followed by another person, 'rather you'. Part 2: that person's action takes the past simple with present meaning, 'didn't mention', not 'not to mention'.
explanation.cs: Část 1: would rather + jiná osoba: rather you. Část 2: po této vazbě následuje minulý čas, i když mluvíme o přítomnosti: didn't mention.

items.sentence1: Nobody was surprised that the team was defeated.
fullAnswers: defeat came as no surprise to
defeat was not a surprise to
loss came as no surprise to
loss was not a surprise to

explanation.en: Part 1: the passive verb 'was defeated' becomes the noun 'defeat' after 'The team's'. Part 2: 'Nobody was surprised' becomes 'came as no surprise to anyone'.
explanation.cs: Část 1: sloveso was defeated převedeme na podstatné jméno defeat (porážka). Část 2: ustálené spojení come as no surprise to somebody = nikoho nepřekvapit.

items.sentence1: We need someone to fix the heating before winter.
fullAnswers: get someone to fix the heating
get someone to repair the heating

explanation.en: Part 1: the causative 'get something done' puts the object straight after 'get'. Part 2: the object is followed by the past participle 'fixed'. 'Get someone to fix the heating' is also correct.
explanation.cs: Část 1: get something done = nechat něco udělat: get the heating. Část 2: příčestí minulé fixed. Správně je i get someone to fix the heating.
